rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF KATHLEEN MULANEY
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 08/26/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) Bond is required for out of state residents. A declaration setting forth in detail the anticipated liabilities of the decedent and claims against the estate is required to determine appropriate bond. (San Francisco Local Rule 14.16.F). 2) Petition is incomplete. In Item 5a, box (3) or (4) must be checked, and box (7) or (8) must be checked. 3) When second generation or more distant heirs are listed, the deceased ancestor(s) through whom they take (or would have taken) must be named, the relationship(s) to the decedent stated, and the date(s) of death specified (LRSF 14.18.C.3). 4) All beneficiaries of the will must be listed in Item 8. 5) No Duties and Liabilities has been filed (Probate Code Section 8404). 6) No Confidential Statement of Birth Date and Driver's License Number (Form DE-147S) has been filed (San Francisco Local Rule 14.18.E). 7) No proof of publication has been filed (Probate Code Section 8120 and 8121). 8) No Notice of Petition to Administer Estate (Form DE-121) has been filed (Probate Code Section 8100). All notices must include language about remote appearances (San Francisco Local Rule 14.1.C.6). 9) No proposed order has been received or lodged with the court (San Francisco Local Rule 14.7.A). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/12/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
